title: Rule 30 — A Simple Rule That Generates Chaos
description:
One 8-case rule, applied to a single cell, 204 times in a row. No randomness anywhere — yet the pattern that emerges is genuinely chaotic. This is Rule 30, once used as Mathematica's random number generator.
